rules.statement: A tenant protected by the Rent Restriction Act cannot be ejected except under specific conditions outlined in Section 13 of the Act, regardless of changes in ownership through fidei commissary succession or other legal means.
rules.supporting_quote: "Although the common law relationship of landlord and tenant between the co-owners and herself was extinguished, a statutory relationship was created in its place which prevented them from ejecting her except upon one or other of the conditions permitted in Section 13."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 13 of the Rent Restriction Act No. 29 of 1948 (Chapter 274)
